title: Worker check record (F154-FR-034 to F154-FR-036; data-model.md D6)
description: The result of a group's frozen acceptance check, run by the runtime in the worker's tree after the worker's pass has ended and before the barrier closes (F154-FR-034; CQ-154-04 A). PROPOSAL of spec 154. The record is bound to the tree's content fingerprint before and after the check: a difference reads `tainted`, which withholds (F154-FR-035; WC-3). The check can only withhold that worker's delta: it approves, keeps and releases nothing (F154-FR-034), and its result reaches no gate and no critic. A failure refuses the delta with `group-check` (proposed, row 63; WC-2). A group with no resolvable check is `unchecked` and its delta goes on to the merge check (WC-4). Decided by `worker-check-table.json`. A ledger kind `parallel` (row 184, proposed).

check.description: The group's declared acceptance check, or null when none resolves (then the result is `unchecked`).

tree.description: The worker tree the check ran in (opaque to every critic-class input; F142-FR-056).

limitSeconds.description: The check's declared limit, in force for this run.

fingerprintBefore.description: The tree store's snapshot fingerprint taken before the check.

fingerprintAfter.description: The tree store's snapshot fingerprint taken after the check.

result.description: WC-1 passed, WC-2 failed, WC-3 tainted, WC-4 unchecked.

exitCode.description: The check's exit code; null when it was ended at its limit.

refusalReason.description: Present only on WC-2: the reason the delta is refused with (proposed, row 63). One repair is charged to every task of the group and the group counts as failed (F154-FR-036).
